title: Morgan Wallen announces a 2027 stadium tour
summary: The Last Time I Checked Tour has 14 shows in seven US cities, starting in Tampa in June.
body:
Country star Morgan Wallen has announced a stadium tour of the United States for summer 2027.

The Last Time I Checked Tour has 14 shows in seven cities, with two nights in each. It opens at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Florida, on 11 June and ends at Nissan Stadium in Nashville on 28 August.

Where he is playing

  • Tampa, Florida: 11 and 12 June
  • Foxborough, Massachusetts: 25 and 26 June
  • Athens, Georgia: 16 and 17 July
  • Buffalo, New York: 23 and 24 July
  • Columbus, Ohio: 6 and 7 August
  • Arlington, Texas: 13 and 14 August
  • Nashville, Tennessee: 27 and 28 August

Brooks & Dunn, HARDY and Thomas Rhett will appear as special guests on different dates. Tickets go on general sale on 20 November.

Sources: Deadline, Parade, Hollywood Life.
